intent: A person's tax number, when provided, must be a valid German tax number (Steuernummer).
notes: Custom-field-TYPE validity (the ValidType/InvalidType operator, built 2026-06-08): Invalid(field, "Type") delegates to a registered custom field-type verifier. Chosen DELIBERATELY UNAMBIGUOUS — a Steuernummer has a checksum, so no regex (PatternViolated) captures it; the registered-type check is the only correct tool, so a regex candidate is genuinely non-equivalent (unlike the email case T3 avoided). Polarity: Invalid (the rule fires on a value that is NOT a valid Steuernummer), guarded by FieldFilled so a missing tax number is not flagged. The type name is NOT validated at model-check time (the kernel accepts any string and validates it only at runtime — see the ValidType catalog gotcha / WORKSPACE-CORPUS item 10), so this is a check-time-verifiable authoring task. Uses the person fixture (a TaxId string field was added for it).
